note: Rewritten from the English species-level description in Bacchus (1997); the original has all three castes, alate, soldier and major worker, and this entry takes the alate section together with the one row of the measurement table that could be verified (head length); the other rows of the table have shifted columns in the OCR and are not cited.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to orange-yellow, with many yellow punctures scattered at the hair bases; frons and middle of the vertex paler; anteclypeus and labrum yellowish white, postclypeus pale yellow; labrum, pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum pale yellow, the pronotum distinctly paler than the head; antennae pale yellow, segments 1 and 2 darker; abdomen and legs uniformly pale yellow. Wings pale yellow to yellow, the costa deep yellow. Posterior margin of the head capsule arcuate, evenly rounded; setae numerous above the compound eyes and few behind them, none exceeding the eye bulge; vertex with several ridges in the fontanelle region; fontanelle absent; median spot oval, smaller than the ocelli; epicranial suture absent, sometimes V-shaped; frons smooth, sloping gently towards the postclypeus; postclypeus shield-shaped, the median line weak. Labrum shorter than wide. Compound eyes and ocelli oval, the ocelli close to the compound eyes. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 1 and 2 subequal. Pronotum with numerous setae, anterior and posterior margins slightly concave. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum forming a broad V. Wings very long, extending beyond the abdomen, about as long as the body or longer. Measurements (8 individuals, 5 nest series): head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 1.05—1.18 mm (mean 1.07 mm, type 1.10 mm).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow, dull yellow to orange; labrum the same colour as the head or slightly darker; mandibles brown to red-brown, yellow at the base; antennae pale yellow or yellow; postmentum the same colour as the genae; pronotum, abdomen and legs yellowish white, pale yellow, yellow to pale orange. Head capsule nearly rectangular, the sides narrowing forwards behind the antennal sockets; cephalic setae a few short hairs together with a few long ones, arranged regularly and symmetrically; labrum ligulate, extending beyond the middle (of the mandibles).
